about: Susanna is a story about a brave woman who was blamed for something she didn't do, and a wise young man who helped.

pages.title: Daniel Finds the Truth
pages.scene: Young Daniel asking questions while Susanna prays
pages.text: Two mean men told lies about Susanna. Everyone believed them. Susanna prayed to God. Then young Daniel spoke up: "Ask each man separately!" Each man told a different story, so everyone knew they were lying. Susanna was safe.
pages.lesson: Always tell the truth. God protects the innocent.
